verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships as an official TypeScript package (`npm install better-auth`) with a documented server API (`auth.api` methods) and a client SDK (`authClient`, e.g. `signUp.email`) that work across many JS frameworks. Community feedback says the client library is JS-only, with virtually no documentation for writing clients in other languages such as iOS. missing for 10: official SDKs beyond JavaScript/TypeScript (e.g. Swift/mobile or other server languages), documentation for building non-JS clients, independent corroboration of SDK breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: To authenticate a user on the server, you can use the auth.api methods.
To sign up a user you need to call the client method `signUp.email`
Works with your stack. Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Astro, Hono, and 20+ more.
Better Auth is a framework-agnostic, universal authentication and authorization framework for TypeScript.
